messages:
maria: :rotating_light: paging - noticed spike in TLS handshake failures and 5xx from Cloudflare edges to api.redwood.com, started ~12:02 UTC. dashboards show increased 520/523 and some NXDOMAINs. @jamal are you oncall?

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident triggered - High error rate on /v1/generate (svc: api)

maria: error rates ~30% for EU and some NA edge pops. traces show `tls: handshake failure` and intermittent DNS NXDOMAIN from some resolvers. cf status looks like partial outage (checking).

jamal: I'm on it. grabbing logs + doing dig from several regions now.

jamal: dig @1.1.1.1 api.redwood.com +short -> 104.16.50.2; dig @8.8.8.8 api.redwood.com -> intermittent NXDOMAIN. doing tcpdump on edge connector.

olivia: seeing identical 520/523 return codes in our edge logs. affects inbound client requests before we hit origin.

leo: pinging cf-status-bot for visibility.

cf-status-bot: Cloudflare incident abc123 - Partial service degradation affecting DNS resolution and TLS handshakes in EU region. https://status.cloudflare.com/incidents/abc123

maria: impact summary: API endpoints returning 5xx for ~40% of EU traffic, retries sometimes succeed. receiving customer reports. ETA unknown from Cloudflare.

jamal: quick mitigation proposal: 1) enable direct-origin fallback (bypass CF) for critical routes (auth, token, generate) 2) failover to alt-domain using our ALB (api-direct.redwood.internal) 3) push temporary retry/backoff to SDKs. thoughts?

maria: agree. step 1: create routing rule to set header `x-ignore-cdn: 1` and route to origin-gateway for `/v1/auth`, `/v1/token`, `/v1/generate`. will canary first.

jamal: applying canary (10%). patch:
```
route:
  - match: 
      prefix: "/v1/generate"
    set_request_headers:
      x-ignore-cdn: "1"
    upstream: origin-gateway
```

jamal: canary applied. monitoring metrics.

olivia: canary result: latency stable, error-rate for canary drops from 35% -> 2% within 30s. :thumbsup:

leo: rolling to 50% now.

maria: rolling full for auth/token/generate. leaving static assets + embeddings on CDN for now.

pagerduty: reminder - escalate to SE/network if network-level mitigations needed.

jamal: after full roll: overall error rate down to ~4% globally, EU ~6% but trending down. CF status still shows DNS flap.

maria: customer-impact note for status page: some EU customers may see intermittent 5xx; we deployed a routing change to direct-origin which reduces errors. recommending SDK users point to `api-direct.redwood.internal` as a temporary workaround.

olivia: support queue: ~18 tickets marked CNV-Cloudflare. support-ops please use canned response v3.1 and include fallback host.

ken: any risk with direct-origin (cookies, tokens, rate-limiting)? we preserve auth headers and quota in gateway, no token re-issuance. watch on rate limits.

jamal: Cloudflare status update: T+45m - mitigation in progress but full recovery unknown. They suggest customers may bypass CF via alternate A/CNAME if urgent.

maria: decision: keep origin-direct routing active for critical routes until CF confirms stable. schedule handoff notes for next oncall.

leo: preparing handoff doc and status.redwood.com post. will include CF incident link and mitigation steps.

maria: handoff summary for night oncall:
- incident created 2365987654 at 2026-03-15T12:02:34Z
- root cause: third-party Cloudflare DNS/Edge partial outage causing TLS handshake failures and intermittent NXDOMAINs
- mitigation: enabled origin-direct routing (api-direct) for critical routes; canary -> 100% rollout completed
- current state: error-rate reduced to ~3-6%, monitoring stable; CF still showing partial degradation
- customer impact: intermittent 5xx for EU customers; support tickets open (INC-4521)
- next actions for oncall: keep origin-direct in place until CF clears; if CF says resolved but errors persist, escalate to networks to lower DNS TTLs or advise customers to point to `api-direct`

olivia: support-ops: copying canned response and contacting top affected customers.

support-ops: contacting affected customers now; updating INC-4521 with updates and workarounds.

jamal: verification curl for account teams:
```
curl -v -H "Host: api.redwood.com" -H "x-ignore-cdn: 1" https://api.redwood.com/v1/health
```

maria: note telemetry: routing direct adds ~40ms tail latency but acceptable tradeoff vs 5xx.

leo: posted to status.redwood.com with mitigation steps and CF link.

cf-status-bot: Cloudflare update at T+1h: partial restoration observed in some EU pops; monitoring continues.

jamal: moving to watch state. no further config changes planned unless error-rate increases >10%.

maria: handing off to night oncall @ken at 14:10 UTC. ken - call me if it spikes.

ken: acknowledged. will monitor dashboards and escalate if needed. :white_check_mark:

maria: closing thread for now, incident remains open in tracker. will update if CF posts full resolution.
